CIVIL JUDGE (JR.DN) AND JMFC, KUNDAPURA IN CRIME NO.51/2023 ANNEXURE-A AND B AND ETC.,
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING IN 'B' GROUP, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER Learned counsel for the petitioners files a memo seeking permission to withdraw the petition.
2.

The memo reads as follows:
"MEMO FOR WITHDRAWAL
It is submitted that during the pendency of the above petition, the respondent No.1 has filed charge sheet against the petitioners.

In view of the same, the Petitioner above named craves leave of this Hon'ble court NC:
2024:KHC:50803 to withdraw the above writ petition as not pressed with liberty to file a fresh petition challenging the charge sheet.
Hence the petitioner prays that this Hon'ble court may be pleased to take the memo on record and permit the petitioner to withdraw the writ petition in the interest of justice & equity."
In terms of the memo, the writ petition is disposed as withdrawn.
